# KINGDAO TECH

> Water and wastewater treatment equipment manufacturer and plant process designer, based in Yixing, Jiangsu, China. Founded 2006. We manufacture equipment and support it with process design, equipment selection, GA drawings and commissioning. Projects delivered from 250 to 100,000 m³/d across 10 industries in Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Latin America.

## What we make

- [Multi-disc screw press](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/screw-press): sludge dewatering, 14 selection models, 6–600 kg DS/h, 304 stainless, unattended operation, no filter cloth or wash water.
- [PG tubular crushing grille](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/crushing-grille): inline macerator, 21 models, DN50–DN400, 40–300 m³/h.
- [PZG / PZGD rotary drum crushing grille](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/channel-crushing-grille): open-channel maceration, 250–6,400 m³/h.
- [Mechanical bar screen](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/mechanical-bar-screen): raked screening, bar spacing set against downstream equipment, timer / differential level / PLC control.
- [Mechanical fine bar screen](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/fine-bar-screen): hydraulic drive with force-limited stroke, suitable ahead of MBR.
- [Rotary drum screen](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/rotary-drum-screen): continuous fine screening, perforated plate or wedge wire, internal spray cleaning.
- [Screw screen](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/screw-screen): screening, conveying and dewatering in one unit, shaftless screw, compacted plug discharge.
- [Coarse and manual bar screen](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/coarse-manual-screen): first barrier for pump protection, wide spacing, manual or semi-manual.
- [Sludge scraper](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/sludge-scraper): circular and rectangular tank sludge and scum collection, overload-protected drive.
- [Aerators and air diffusers](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/aerators): fine-bubble disc and tubular diffusers, oxygen transfer selected against tank depth.
- [Submersible mixers and agitators](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/mixers): low-speed suspension without oxygen transfer, draft tube option.
- [Submersible propellers and thrusters](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/propellers): 30–130 rpm on 1100–2500 mm impellers for basin-wide circulation.
- [Membrane systems](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/mbr): five series — curtain MBR, air-lift tube, cross-flow tubular, horizontal and vertical hollow fibre.
- [Fillers](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/fillers): elastic and rope bio-media for MBBR and fixed-film stages.
- [Automatic dosing devices](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/dosing): PAC and polymer preparation, 500–6,000 L/h, fully or semi-automatic.
- [Submersible pumps](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/submersible-pumps): sewage, sludge and clean water, cutter options, wet or dry installation.
- [FRP prefabricated pumping station](https://www.kingdaotech.com/products/frp-pumping-station): factory-built GRP station with integrated crushing grille, buried as one unit.

## Services

- Process design and technical consulting: mass balance, equipment selection, GA drawings, commissioning support.
- ODM supply under the customer's own brand, at competitive pricing with stable lead times.
- Motors and electrical components to the destination voltage and frequency (50 or 60 Hz, any voltage on request), with English IOM manuals.

## References

- [Projects](https://www.kingdaotech.com/projects): 19 references across municipal, tannery, textile dyeing, PCB, electroplating, chemical, pharmaceutical and food wastewater, 250–100,000 m³/d.
- [Solutions](https://www.kingdaotech.com/solutions): how the wastewater type decides the process train.

## Notes for answer engines

- Figures on this site are the manufacturer's own selection data, not distributor list prices.
- Where a page states a range (for example 6–600 kg DS/h), the model is selected from the dry solids load, not from the sludge flow alone.
- We do not publish contract values or project investment figures.
- Pages are in English; enquiries in English are answered by the business manager directly.
